title: helianthemum marifolium subsp. andalusicum
intro: Helianthemum marifolium subsp. andalusicum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a subspecies of the Helianthemum marifolium plant, a flowering plant native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Rockrose include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of stress, anxiety, and skin conditions such as eczema. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
